policy_description: Conditions that must ALL be satisfied before QSBKernelCore may be instantiated.
notes: kernel_installed_required: The installation socket manifest must record kernel_installed=true before any kernel class may be instantiated.
operator_approval_required: A human operator must explicitly record approval in operator_kernel_approval.json.
security_spine_clearance_required: The tower security spine must sign off on the activation.
path_rebase_required: The rebased kernel must have zero old-vault path references.
rebased_kernel_unit_tests_required: A dedicated unit test suite over the rebased kernel sub-cores must pass before activation.
